1.Note: #45 leads the field to green on the inside, #11 outside.  Both remain side-by-side the entire lap with #5 slotting into 3rd

2.Note: #11 and #45 touch briefly in turn 1 with #45 clearing for the lead in turn 2.

3.Note: #19 moves to 3rd, #77 passes #5 for 4th in turn 3

4.Note: #11 passes #45 for the lead on the backstretch

5.Note: #45 passes #11 for the lead in turn 1 but #11 fights back off turn 2

17.Note: #77 passes #5 for 4th, #11 maintains a 1.38 second lead over #45

33.Note: #60, #43, #42 all pit as the green flag pit cycle begins

39.Note: #11 (1st), #1, #19, #23, #12, #20, #35, #16, #71 all pit.  #77 cycles to the lead.  #12 hits #16 as he exits his pit stall causing #16 to spin

40.Note: #77 pits from the lead, #22 also pits.  #11 cycles back to the lead.  #77 suffers a 15+ second stop after a broken gun on the left rear

41.Note: #11 now leads #5 by 2.017 seconds.  #45 runs in 3rd, 2.4 seconds behind

53.Note: #11 continues to maintain a 2.7 second lead over #5.

64.Note: #77, who suffered a broken gun on his pit stop at lap 40, has already recovered to 11th

72.Note: #11 has lapped up to #22 who runs 24th

84.Note: All lead lap cars pit.  #11 gets off pit road first followed by #5 and #9

87.Note: #41 takes the wave around to return to the lead lap.  #1 and #16 wave to get back to just one lap down

89.Note: Restart: #11 leads from the inside, #5 outside.  #11 clears for the lead by turn 2, #5 slots into 2nd before looking inside #11 in turn 3.  #5 clears for the lead off turn 4, while #9 gets a big run off turn 4 to battle for 2nd

90.Note: #9 clears for 2nd, #45 gets alongside #11 for 3rd in turn 2 but can't complete the pass

114.Note: #5 has just passed Kevin Harvick for the most laps led at Kansas in Cup all-time (950 and counting)

127.Note: #77 and #12 both pit to complete the pit cycle.  #5 now leads #9 by 2.1 seconds

135.Note: #5 has extended his lead to 4.84 seconds over #11

158.Note: #11 has cut the lead to 1.97 seconds behind #5.  #45 runs 3rd ahead of #9 and #20

165.Note: #5 wins stage 2 followed by #11, #45, #9 and #20.  This is the 2nd Kansas Cup race where both stages went caution free (May 2024)

169.Note: All lead lap cars pit.  #11 gets off pit road first followed by #20 and #5.  #9 gets blocked by #2 exiting his stall and drops to 12th

173.Note: Restart: #11 leads from the inside, #20 outside.  #11 clears for the lead by turn 2, #23, #5 and #45 battle 3-wide for 3rd on the backstretch before #23 clears for the spot

174.Note: #20 passes #11 on the outside between turns 1-2 to take the lead

175.Note: This is the 9th consecutive Kansas race #20 has led, however he has yet to win here

222.Note: #20 pits from the lead.  #11 easily comes out in front of #20 after stops

223.Note: #7 leads, but slows after going high in turns 1-2

230.Note: #20, running 3rd, nearly brushes the turn 4 wall but continues

252.Note: #45 has cut the lead to 1.129 seconds behind #11

257.Note: #45 looks inside of #11 to battle for the lead off turn 4

258.Note: #45 passes #11 for the lead in turn 1

261.Note: #11 looks back inside #45 for the lead in turns 3-4 but can't complete the pass

265.Note: #45 brushes the wall after running out of fuel and switching to pump two between turns 3-4 which allows #11 to take the lead

268.Note: All lead lap cars pit.  #11 gets off pit road first after taking 2 tires followed by #45 and #5.  #19 is the first car off pit road that took 4 tires and will restart 11th

270.Note: #48, #34 and #7 take the wave around to return to the lead lap

273.Note: Overtime restart: #11 leads from the inside, #45 outside.  #5 looks inside #11 and #45 to take the lead in turns 1-2.  #45 touches #20, who then brushes the outside wall.  #20 slows with a broken toe link.  #5 leads off turn 4 ahead of #45.

274.Note: #45 gets by #5 between turns 3-4 to take the win by 0.118 seconds.
